Web Release runtime notices
===========================

The Web Release target uses the following runtime dependencies.
RuntimeCredits.json selects this collection for Web/WebGPU only.
Complete bundled notices for selected components are retained together.

DirectXMath: Microsoft, MIT; scalar Web build from commit
f5d82574b03417d905fdd2f85bfa9bf7a2f1deac.
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXMath
Notice: LICENSE_DirectXMath.txt

Emscripten 6.0.13: generated JavaScript support (including filesystem and
persistence) and system runtime. Its complete upstream license includes the
bundled Node.js-derived path code notices.
https://github.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/tree/6.0.13
Notices: LICENSE_Emscripten.txt, LICENSE_Web_Emscripten_Bundled_Notices.txt,
LICENSE_Web_Musl.txt,
LICENSE_Web_Musl_Bundled_Notices.txt, LICENSE_Web_dlmalloc.txt,
LICENSE_Web_Libcxx.txt, LICENSE_Web_Libcxxabi.txt,
LICENSE_Web_CompilerRT.txt, LICENSE_Web_Libunwind.txt,
LICENSE_Web_LLVM_Libc.txt.
The bundled musl notices retain source attribution conservatively, including
some code not selected by wasm32. They supplement musl's complete COPYRIGHT.

Emdawnwebgpu v20260423.175430: Emscripten's WebGPU JavaScript/C++ bridge, Dawn
C++ headers, and WebGPU native C headers; revision
31e25af254ab572c77054edec4946d2244e184dd.
https://github.com/google/dawn/releases/tag/v20260423.175430
Notices: LICENSE_EmdawnWebGPU.txt, LICENSE_Dawn.txt,
LICENSE_WebGPU_Headers.txt.

The MIT-licensed SAL annotations from dotnet/runtime v9.0.2 are used by the
portable DirectXMath headers; retained as LICENSE_DotNet_SAL.txt.
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/v9.0.2/src/coreclr/pal/inc/rt/sal.h

Slang 2026.20 is a build-time shader compiler. It is not shipped in the game.
Its complete LICENSE, LICENSES, and third-party-notices remain in the installed
Web SDK alongside the compiler. Emsdk, Python, Node, and other SDK tool notices
likewise remain with their unmodified local tool distributions.
